top_signals.title: Oil Prices Surge as U.S. and Iran Exchange Strikes
top_signals.summary: Oil prices climbed in early Asian trade on Monday after the U.S. struck Iran for the first time in over a month, with Iran then retaliating against U.S. bases in Jordan. At the time of writing, WTI front-month futures were trading at $85.46 per barrel, up 2.47%, while Brent front-month futures had climbed 2.71% to $90.49 per barrel. The latest escalation started on Sunday when U.S. forces struck two Iranian rocket launchers on Larak Island, which sits inside the Strait of Hormuz. According to a U.S. Central Command spokesperson, the attack came…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: GPIF Would Be Justified in Buying More Japan Bonds, Analysts Say
top_signals.summary: Japanese bond yields have climbed so sharply that analysts say Government Pension Investment Fund may be justified in eventually raising its domestic debt allocation target from 25% to seek higher returns.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Real Trump Coins denies launching GOLD token, blames ‘bad actors’
top_signals.summary: Trump-linked Real Trump Coins said it never authorized GOLD or any digital token as questions persisted over its X account, associated domains and the concentrated token supply.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Cosmos Labs says it wrongly cleared the bug behind a $5.7 million six-chain hack
top_signals.summary: MANTRA Chain, which lost $3.6 million, claimed the patch was only released 20 hours before the attack began and did not identify the flaw it fixed.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Kalshi becomes exclusive prediction market partner of US Open: report
top_signals.summary: As part of the agreement, rival prediction market platforms are reportedly barred from advertising at the tournament and on its ESPN broadcasts.
